body.p: The Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion plugin can be installed on a Content Fusion server to enable the use of a specific AI engine (OpenAI, MS Azure AI, Claude, etc.) for chat or for running useful predefined actions.
Download the plugin from: Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion Installation.
You can then install the plugin on the Content Fusion server, making the AI Positron side-pane accessible. For information about its features, see .

p.note: The AI Positron side-pane appears in the UI only if the plugin is configured by an administrator.

body.p: Configure the connection details for the AI engine as follows.

section.title: Configuring the Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion Plugin

ol.li: Go to the Web Author tab.

li.p: Click the Configure icon next to the Oxygen AI Positron for Content Fusion plugin to open the Plugin configuration dialog box.
In the AI Service tab, specify the connector and configure the necessary details.

section.title: Automatic Connection to the Content Fusion MCP Server
section.p: When the Content Fusion server has its MCP server support started, AI Positron automatically connects to it. This connection gives the LLM access to tools that can create or modify review tasks directly from the AI Positron chat.
